acip: GONG GI RTAGS GNYIS PA MA GRUB NA, RTAG PA CHOS CAN, KHYOD RTAG PA'I SPYI DANG BYE BRAG GNYIS KA MA YIN PA'I BYE BRAG YIN PAR THAL, KHYOD RTAG PA'I SPYI DANG BYE BRAG GNYIS KA MA YIN PA YIN, KHYOD RTAG PA'I SPYI DANG BYE BRAG GNYIS KA MA YIN PA DANG BDAG GCIG TU 'BREL, KHYOD MA YIN ZHING RTAG PA'I SPYI DANG BYE BRAG GNYIS KA MA YIN PA YIN PA'I GZHI MTHUN PA DU MA GRUB PA'I PHYIR,
wylie: gong gi rtags gnyis pa ma grub na, rtag pa chos can, khyod rtag pa'i spyi dang bye brag gnyis ka ma yin pa'i bye brag yin par thal, khyod rtag pa'i spyi dang bye brag gnyis ka ma yin pa yin, khyod rtag pa'i spyi dang bye brag gnyis ka ma yin pa dang bdag gcig tu 'brel, khyod ma yin zhing rtag pa'i spyi dang bye brag gnyis ka ma yin pa yin pa'i gzhi mthun pa du ma grub pa'i phyir
english: Then I disagree to the second reason from before: I disagree that unchanging things are characteristic of a quality but not both a quality of unchanging things and characteristic of unchanging things. Suppose you do disagree. Let's again consider unchanging things. They are so characteristic of a quality but not both a quality of unchanging things and characteristic of unchanging things, Because (1) they are something which is neither a quality of unchanging things nor characteristic of unchanging things; (2) they share a relationship with that which is neither a quality of unchanging things nor characteristic of unchanging things where to be them is to be it; and (3) there do exist many examples of things which are not them, but are still that which is neither a quality of unchanging things nor characteristic of unchanging things.
